title: Mixed Event — Musical Twilight Parade — Episode8 Increasing Hesitation

meta.Event Outline: Shiho has been scouted by a band that's ready to make its big debut, giving her a lot to think about. Then, Saki invites her on a visit to Phoenix Wonderland. Meanwhile, Tsukasa and the rest of WxS make their own preparations, eager to host them!

rows.Line: Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Sigh... Talk about a surprise.
I wasn't expecting a question like that at all...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Teehee☆ You should've seen how happy you looked when you were answering her, Nene♪ You were thinking about Emu and the others, right?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wh-What are you talking about...?
Okay, well... I may've felt like that a little...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm not sure if my answer was good or bad, but I really hope it helps her with whatever's on her mind.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Kusanagi...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Oh... H-Hoshino?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um... Wh-What is it?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
It's that I...
I'm the vocalist for our band.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But it's not going as well as I'd hoped...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I really want to get better for Shiho...
No, for everyone!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
When I heard you sing, I was really touched!
I want to be able to sing like you too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: L-Like me...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So if you don't mind... Can you please teach me how to sing?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I know you're probably busy with school and practice so... Whenever you're free! It doesn't have to be regular!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (My singing is actually touching the hearts of the people listening to me. People like Hinomori and Hoshino...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'm really happy but teaching someone...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Come on, Nene! You got this!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay. If you're sure you want me to.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Gasp...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Th-Thank you! Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Also you don't have to be so formal with me. I'm guessing we're around the same age so...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, you're right...!
Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sorry to keep you waiting...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi! You sure took your time...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Did you find what you were looking for?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. I have what I need.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That's great!
Let's go grab us some souvenirs now!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Teaching her how to sing...
Am I even capable of that?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<You'll be fine♪
And I'll be there to help you too☆>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Right... Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene looks really happy☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Her singing was a lot more polished than usual today. She must have been practicing hard by herself.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I didn't like how she completely overshadowed me, but I'll allow it since she did make Saki and her friends really happy.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wh-Why are you all staring at me like that...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's nothing! It's not like anyone saw you smirking by yourself over there at all...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
How'd you know that if you didn't see?
And I'm not alone. Rin's here too.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hello, everyone♪>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Whoa, it's really Rin!
Did you get to see our show too?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I did☆ And everyone was brilliant♪>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmph... It goes without saying that I was the most brilliant of us all, yes?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Whatever you say.

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Man, that was so much fun...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. The show was really nice too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thanks for inviting us here, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Teehee! No need to thank me! After all, I was just looking for an excuse to hang out with everyone!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: In exchange for practicing harder starting tomorrow, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Y-Yup... I'll practice until I can play that part I was struggling with the other day!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But before that... Here you go♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? What's this?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
A limited edition Phenny Penguin keychain!
I bought one for each of us!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, when did you do that...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe♪ Secretly, before we left!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Remember what Emu said?
PXL is a place where people come to have fun
and make fond memories together!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I wanted us all to have something to remember this day by!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you!
Now we have matching keychains!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Aren't they awesome♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Here's yours, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you. I'll put it in my bag for now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ah, Shiho! You dropped something.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Is that a ticket?
Are you going to see a show?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Gasp...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Playing in a band as a hobby and doing it professionally are completely different things. You won't make it as a pro unless you absolutely commit to it.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Which is why I don't want bandmates who're only playing for fun and don't have the resolve to really take it seriously.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: We have a night performance this weekend. If you're still on the fence, come and see us play before making a decision.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
It's nothing. I got it from someone at work.
Don't worry about it...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, okay...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow... I hope we can hold our own show one day...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Me too! But we'll need a lot more practice before we can even think about it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Urgh... I'll do my best!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Let's visit PXL another day too!
I wanna watch Tsukasa perform again!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
We should!
I really want to hear Kusanagi sing again too...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And Emu did say she would continue showing us around next time.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I like playing with everyone as Leo/need.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But they're not thinking about becoming professionals...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (So I probably shouldn't force them to spend time practicing with me...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I'm sure they'd rather have fun by hanging out together instead of practicing like this.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Which is why I...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Shiho, are you okay?
You seem a little down...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm fine, don't worry about me...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, really. I have to go now so...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, okay!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: See you tomorrow, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yup. Bye then...
Live House

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Hinomori?
I thought you were off today.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm here as a spectator today.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Oh, you're here to see STANDOUT. They've really been getting a lot of attention lately. Well, I hope you enjoy yourself.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you, I will...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm just here to watch them perform.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's all...
